description: Pseudonymised patient identifier used to link the patient-level and event-level outputs.
derivation: Provided by the OpenSAFELY output.
notes: Highly sensitive. Never include in released aggregate outputs.

description: Patient date of birth extracted to calculate and verify age at each candidate event.
derivation: Direct patient-level extraction used by the downstream candidate-event transformation.
notes: The name is deliberately marked for QA and can be replaced by a production-oriented derivation later.

description: Pseudonymised patient identifier for the candidate hospital record.
derivation: Returned for patients in the event-level dataset population.
notes: Highly sensitive.

description: Admission date of an APCS record that can generate a candidate hip-fracture index event.
derivation: APCS records whose all_diagnoses field contains a listed hip-fracture ICD-10 code and whose admission date falls in a permitted candidate period.
notes: Multiple records on the same patient-date are collapsed downstream.

description: Identifier of the contributing APCS record.
derivation: Direct extraction from each candidate APCS record.
notes: Negative values can occur in generated dummy data and have no clinical meaning.

description: Pseudonymised patient identifier for a hospital history record.
time_window: All available history returned for the event-level population
derivation: Returned for patients with at least one candidate hip admission.
notes: Highly sensitive.

description: Admission date of a hip-fracture APCS record used for candidate-specific lookbacks.
time_window: All available history returned for the event-level population
derivation: APCS records whose all_diagnoses field contains a listed hip-fracture ICD-10 code. Candidate-period exclusions are not applied.
notes: Records outside the index period are retained because they may affect a later candidate.

description: Identifier of the contributing APCS history record.
time_window: All available history returned for the event-level population
derivation: Direct extraction from each hip-fracture APCS record.
notes: Used to distinguish record counts from distinct event-date counts.

description: Pseudonymised patient identifier for a GP hip-fracture history record.
time_window: All available history returned for the event-level population
derivation: Returned for patients with at least one candidate hip admission.
notes: GP hip records currently contribute to history but do not generate hip index candidates.

description: Date of a GP hip-fracture record used for candidate-specific lookbacks.
time_window: All available history returned for the event-level population
derivation: Clinical-event records whose SNOMED CT code is in the hip-fracture codelist.
qa_status: recent, old, future and same-day GP tests passed
notes: Only records before the candidate date can count as prior history.

description: SNOMED CT code recorded for the contributing GP hip-fracture event.
time_window: All available history returned for the event-level population
derivation: Direct extraction from matching clinical-event records.
notes: Store as text to preserve the code exactly.

description: Pseudonymised patient identifier for a GP registration period.
time_window: All available registration history returned for the event-level population
derivation: Direct event-level extraction.
notes: Highly sensitive.

description: Start date of the GP registration period.
time_window: All available registration history returned for the event-level population
derivation: Direct event-level extraction.
notes: One registration record must start on or before the three-month lookback boundary.

description: End date of the GP registration period.
time_window: All available registration history returned for the event-level population
derivation: Direct event-level extraction. A missing value represents an ongoing registration.
notes: The qualifying registration must end on or after the candidate date, or have no end date.

description: Pseudonymised patient identifier for the candidate event.
derivation: Carried from the deduplicated candidate admission records.
notes: A patient may contribute more than one row.

description: Sequential technical identifier for a candidate-event row.
derivation: Assigned after sorting unique candidates by patient_id and index_date.
notes: Not a persistent clinical identifier and may change if the input data or sorting changes.

description: Unique candidate hip-fracture admission date for the patient.
derivation: Candidate APCS records are grouped by patient_id and admission_date; one row is retained per distinct date.
qa_status: wide and long dummy outputs manually reconciled
notes: Only eligible rows will become final index events.

description: Fracture type represented by the candidate row.
derivation: Currently assigned the constant value hip.
notes: Will require additional allowed values when the framework is extended.

description: Record source that generated the candidate index event.
derivation: Currently assigned the constant value hospital because hip candidates are generated from APCS.
notes: GP hip records currently contribute only to prior-history ascertainment.

description: Number of candidate APCS records occurring for the same patient on the candidate date.
derivation: Count of APCS candidate records grouped by patient_id and admission_date.
notes: The candidate row itself represents one distinct patient-date event.

description: Number of hip-fracture APCS records during the preceding six-month window.
time_window: From six calendar months before index_date up to but excluding index_date
derivation: Count history records for the same patient where admission_date is on or after the boundary and before index_date.
notes: Counts records, so multiple APCS records on one date can increase the count.

description: Number of distinct hip-fracture hospital dates during the preceding six-month window.
time_window: From six calendar months before index_date up to but excluding index_date
derivation: Count distinct admission_date values among qualifying history records for the same patient.
notes: Included to distinguish clinical dates from raw record counts.

description: Number of GP hip-fracture records during the preceding six-month window.
time_window: From six calendar months before index_date up to but excluding index_date
derivation: Count GP history records for the same patient where event_date is on or after the boundary and before index_date.
qa_status: recent, old, future and same-day GP tests passed
notes: Counts GP records rather than distinct dates.

description: Whether any hip-fracture evidence is present in hospital or GP records during the preceding six months.
codelist_or_code_set: Hip-fracture ICD-10 and SNOMED CT codelists
time_window: From six calendar months before index_date up to but excluding index_date
derivation: True when either prior record count is greater than zero.
notes: This is the combined prior-history flag used by the current prototype.

description: Whether the candidate has no recorded hip fracture during the preceding six months.
codelist_or_code_set: Hip-fracture ICD-10 and SNOMED CT codelists
time_window: At candidate date using the preceding six months
derivation: Logical inverse of has_prior_same_type_fracture_6m.
notes: A non-null candidate with no prior evidence passes this rule.

description: Completed age in years on the candidate date.
derivation: Difference between index year and birth year, reduced by one when the birthday has not yet occurred that year.
qa_status: age-change and exact-18 boundary tests passed
notes: Calculated separately for every candidate event.

description: Whether the patient is at least 18 years old on the candidate date.
derivation: True when age_at_index is at least 18.
qa_status: age-change and exact-18 boundary tests passed
notes: A patient can fail for an earlier candidate and pass for a later one.

description: Whether one GP registration record spans the complete three-month period before the candidate and includes the candidate date.
time_window: From three calendar months before index_date through index_date
derivation: True when start_date is on or before the three-month boundary and end_date is missing or on or after index_date.
notes: Separate adjacent registration records are not joined by the current derivation.

description: Whether the candidate satisfies all eligibility conditions currently implemented in the prototype.
derivation: True when all three component indicators are true.
qa_status: end-to-end dummy pipeline produced 24 candidates and 8 eligible events
notes: This is not yet the complete final SAP eligibility definition.

description: Nth distinct candidate hip-fracture admission date for a patient, where n ranges from 1 to 10.
derivation: Iteratively select the earliest remaining candidate date and then restrict later candidates to dates after it.
notes: Technical QA pattern only; not intended for the final analytical table.

description: Hospital hip-fracture record count in the six months before candidate n.
time_window: Six calendar months before candidate n, excluding candidate date
derivation: Count qualifying APCS history records.
notes: n ranges from 1 to 10.

description: GP hip-fracture record count in the six months before candidate n.
time_window: Six calendar months before candidate n, excluding candidate date
derivation: Count qualifying GP history records.
notes: n ranges from 1 to 10.

description: Whether hospital or GP hip-fracture history is present before candidate n.
codelist_or_code_set: Hip-fracture ICD-10 and SNOMED CT codelists
time_window: Six calendar months before candidate n, excluding candidate date
derivation: True when either candidate-specific prior count is greater than zero.
notes: n ranges from 1 to 10.

description: Whether candidate n is present and has no prior hip-fracture evidence in the six-month window.
source_column: candidate date and candidate-specific prior flag
derivation: True for a non-missing candidate date when the prior-fracture flag is false.
notes: n ranges from 1 to 10.

description: Patient age on candidate date n.
derivation: Calculated using ehrQL age_on for each candidate date.
notes: n ranges from 1 to 10.

description: Whether the patient is at least 18 on candidate date n.
derivation: True when candidate age is at least 18.
notes: n ranges from 1 to 10.

description: Whether one registration spans the required three-month period for candidate n.
time_window: Three calendar months before candidate n through candidate n
derivation: Candidate-specific registration span check.
notes: n ranges from 1 to 10.

description: Whether candidate n satisfies the currently implemented six-month, age and registration rules.
derivation: Logical AND of the candidate-specific rule, age and registration indicators.
notes: n ranges from 1 to 10; not the complete final SAP eligibility definition.

description: Whether a patient has at least one additional distinct candidate date after the first ten dates.
derivation: Check whether candidate records remain after iteratively removing the first ten distinct dates.
notes: Used to assess whether the capped wide fallback could omit candidate dates.

description: Total number of candidate APCS records for the patient.
derivation: Count candidate APCS records for the patient.
notes: This is a record count, not necessarily a distinct-date count.

description: Total number of matching GP hip-fracture records for the patient.
derivation: Count all matching GP history records for the patient.
notes: Used for QA rather than candidate generation.
